label: DeepMind — AlphaFold HQ
sub: Origin of AlphaFold protein structure prediction; 214M+ structures freely available, transforming drug discovery and vaccine development globally since 2021

label: MIT — AI Drug Discovery
sub: MIT researchers used deep learning to discover Halicin, the first novel antibiotic in decades, screening 100M+ compounds in days (Cell, February 2020)

label: Google Health — Mountain View
sub: Google AI for breast cancer screening (Nature 2020), flood forecasting, and AlphaMissense genomics; AI deployed across 80+ countries

label: Qure.ai — Mumbai
sub: AI chest X-ray analysis for tuberculosis screening deployed in 1,000+ centers across India and Africa; ~90% sensitivity enabling same-day results in rural areas

label: Nairobi — AI Community Health
sub: Google-supported AI health diagnostics including TB screening and community health worker AI tools deployed across Kenyan public health system

label: Cape Town — AI Pathology
sub: PathAI and local university partnerships deploy AI-powered pathology slide analysis for cancer diagnosis, reducing diagnostic delays from weeks to hours

label: Singapore — AI Health Hub
sub: National AI strategy includes AI diagnostics in all public hospitals; Singapore Health Services AI-powered early sepsis detection and diabetic retinopathy screening deployed nationally

label: Makerere University — Cassava AI
sub: Nuru AI plant disease app for cassava blight detection, reaching 40M+ smallholder farmers across sub-Saharan Africa with offline, multilingual mobile diagnostics

label: Lagos — PlantVillage Network
sub: PlantVillage AI crop disease detection and agricultural advisory network across Nigeria, reaching smallholder maize and cassava farmers with real-time disease alerts

label: Addis Ababa — FAO Locust AI
sub: FAO AI satellite tracking system for desert locust swarms coordinated from Addis Ababa during East Africa's worst infestation in 70 years (2020); protected crops for 25M+ at-risk people

label: Pune — Precision Farming AI
sub: Cropin and ICRISAT AI platforms for precision agriculture serving 7M+ Indian farmers with crop yield prediction, disease alerts, and climate-adaptive farming recommendations

label: São Paulo — EMBRAPA Agri AI
sub: EMBRAPA and Microsoft AI for Agriculture partnership: satellite-based crop monitoring, yield forecasting, and soil health AI covering 60M+ hectares of Brazilian farmland

label: Dhaka — Google Flood AI
sub: Google AI flood forecasting providing 7-day advance alerts in Bangladesh; over 30M people reached via Android, Google Search, and SMS partnerships with national disaster management

label: Tokyo — Seismic Early Warning AI
sub: Japan Meteorological Agency's AI-enhanced earthquake early warning system; machine learning differentiates P-waves and S-waves to issue alerts with 5-10 second lead time before shaking arrives

label: Manila — PAGASA Typhoon AI
sub: Philippines Atmospheric Service AI-enhanced typhoon track prediction and storm surge modeling; critical for one of the world's most typhoon-prone nations with 20 million people in high-risk coastal zones

label: Jakarta — BMKG Flood AI
sub: Indonesian Meteorological Agency AI flood and volcanic hazard monitoring; ML-enhanced early warning for flooding that annually displaces hundreds of thousands of Jakarta residents

label: San Diego — ALERTCalifornia AI
sub: UC San Diego ALERTCalifornia wildfire detection network: 1,000+ AI cameras detect ignition within 8 minutes across California, Oregon, and Nevada; coordinated with CAL FIRE emergency dispatch

label: Kathmandu — ICIMOD Mountain AI
sub: International Centre for Integrated Mountain Development AI for glacier lake outburst flood (GLOF) early warning across the Hindu Kush Himalayan region; protects 240M mountain-dependent people

label: Redmond — Microsoft AI for Accessibility
sub: Microsoft AI for Accessibility program ($25M+ grants); Seeing AI, Project Euphonia for atypical speech, live captions, and AI-powered AAC devices deployed globally for disability communities

label: Copenhagen — Be My Eyes
sub: Be My Eyes integrated GPT-4 Vision in March 2023 to provide 24/7 AI visual assistance to 500K+ blind and low-vision users globally; landmark demonstration of foundation models for disability access

label: Boston — AI Augmentative Communication
sub: Boston-area research institutions and companies developing AI-powered AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) devices; ML models predict intended speech from eye-tracking and brain signals for ALS/motor neuron disease patients

label: Kyoto — AI Hearing Aid Research
sub: Kyoto University and industry partners developing AI-powered hearing aids with real-time noise suppression and speaker separation; ML hearing aids outperform traditional DSP chips in noisy environments

label: Mountain View — Khan Academy Khanmigo
sub: Khan Academy launched Khanmigo (GPT-4 Socratic tutor) in March 2023; deployed across 40+ countries with subsidized access for under-resourced schools globally

label: Paris — UNESCO AI Education
sub: UNESCO AI in Education framework and Global Education Coalition; 2023 guidance on generative AI in schools adopted by 40+ national education ministries; emphasis on equity and teacher training

label: Nairobi — AI Literacy Programs
sub: USAID-supported and Google.org-funded AI literacy programs in Kenya; reaching 500K+ students with AI fundamentals, coding, and critical thinking curricula in English and Swahili

label: Copenhagen — Novo Nordisk AI Drug Discovery
sub: Novo Nordisk HQ in Bagsværd; April 2026 partnership with OpenAI to apply large-scale AI to drug development for diabetes and obesity affecting 800M+ people globally

label: Rome — WFP HungerMap Live
sub: World Food Programme HQ; April 2026 launch of HungerMap Live AI platform providing anticipatory food security intelligence across 50+ countries; 7-to-1 ROI on AI-triggered early intervention vs. reactive response

label: Beijing — DeepDrugDiscovery AI
sub: Mindrank AI DeepDrugDiscovery platform (Nature Biomedical Engineering, April 2026): open-source AI drug screening identifying BBB-permeable Alzheimer's compounds; publicly available at deepdrugdiscovery.mindrank.ai for global research use

label: Geneva — ITU AI for Good
sub: International Telecommunication Union AI for Good programme; global youth robotics challenges, accessibility AI sessions, and July 2026 AI for Good Global Summit at Palexpo; central hub for UN AI for development agenda

label: Rochester — Mayo Clinic AI Hub
sub: Mayo Clinic REDMOD AI detects pancreatic cancer 3 years early (73% sensitivity vs 39% for radiologists, Gut 2026). June 2026: Mayo–Microsoft frontier AI model partnership — trained on Mayo de-identified clinical records, owned by Mayo, licensed globally to extend expertise to underserved hospitals.

label: Western US — AI Wildfire Detection
sub: Pano AI and ALERTCalifornia AI camera networks deployed across 17 US states; 1,240+ cameras detect wildfire ignition ~45 min faster than 911 calls. Pano AI detected 725 wildfires in 2025. AP investigation documented May 2026.

label: Casablanca — GITEX Health Africa
sub: Africa's first dedicated health-AI summit (May 4–6, 2026); 15,000+ visitors, 300+ exhibitors from 30 countries. Focus on AI diagnostics for smartphones, health sovereignty, and locally-trained African AI health models. Morocco national AI health plan 2025–2030.

label: London — DeepMind AI Co-Clinician
sub: Google DeepMind published 'AI co-clinician' research (May 2026): matched or outperformed primary care physicians in 68 of 140 clinical areas, zero critical errors in 97/98 realistic queries. Designed to address WHO-projected 10M health worker shortfall by 2030.

label: Indianapolis — Eli Lilly LillyPod
sub: Eli Lilly opened 'LillyPod' AI supercomputer (1,016 NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs) for pharmaceutical drug discovery; $2.75B Insilico Medicine AI partnership (largest AI drug deal to date); AI drug discovery market confirmed at $1.13B (2026).

label: Cupertino — Apple Accessibility AI
sub: Apple Swift Student Challenge 2026: 350 winners from 37 countries building AI accessibility apps. Highlights include AI tremor-compensation drawing tool (using Anthropic Claude + iPad motion sensors) enabling motor-impaired users. AI accessibility moves mainstream.

label: Brussels — EU AI Literacy Framework
sub: EU Council document ST-9003/26 (May 11, 2026): AI literacy standards and education policy for 27 member states covering 80M+ students. Mandates AI literacy in national curricula, teacher training, and equity standards for AI tools used with minors.

label: Mountain View — Google Flood Hub 700M+
sub: Google Groundsource AI (powered by Gemini, trained on 2.6M geo-tagged news flood reports) expanded Flood Hub to 150+ countries and 700M+ people (May 2026). Provides 24-hour urban flash flood warnings; up from 80+ countries and 460M+ people in 2024.

label: New York — Columbia EchoNext-Mini ECG AI
sub: Columbia University published EchoNext-Mini in NEJM AI (May 18, 2026): AI model trained on 1M+ ECG-echocardiogram pairs detects structural heart disease from routine ECGs, outperforming 13 cardiologists. Open dataset of 100K ECGs released for global research. Key for cardiac screening equity in low-resource settings.

label: Geneva — WHO AI Epidemic Intelligence (WHA79)
sub: 79th World Health Assembly (May 19, 2026): WHO upgraded EIOS AI epidemic intelligence to 120+ countries for daily outbreak detection, and expanded Global Digital Health Certification Network to 82 countries giving 2 billion people access to digital health wallets. WHO frames AI as core pandemic preparedness infrastructure.

label: Singapore — ATxSummit 2026 & OpenAI Applied AI Lab
sub: May 19-20, 2026: ATxSummit showcased ASEAN Youth AI Challenge (accessibility tools for hearing-impaired children, dementia AI, offline rural education AI). OpenAI committed S$300M for first Applied AI Lab outside the US — focused on healthcare, education, and public services. SingHealth signed MoUs to deploy MerMED-FM chest AI in Bhutan (2027).

label: Thimphu — MerMED-FM AI Chest Radiology (Bhutan)
sub: SingHealth and Bhutan's Gyalpozhing College of Information Technology signed MoU at ATxSummit 2026 to deploy MerMED-FM — Singapore-developed AI chest radiograph model for detecting pneumonia, TB, and cancer — across Bhutan's national healthcare system starting 2027. Part of Singapore's AI for healthcare equity initiative in South Asia.

label: Miami — NHC × WeatherNext 2 AI Partnership
sub: US National Hurricane Center (NHC) formally partnered with Google DeepMind's WeatherNext 2 AI model (May 2026) for tropical cyclone track prediction — the first US federal meteorological agency to officially adopt AI weather forecasting for life-safety hurricane guidance covering the Atlantic, Caribbean, and Gulf of Mexico.

label: Nairobi — PlantVillage+ Scales to 500K Users
sub: Strathmore Agri-Food Innovation Center and digital firm Qhala expand AI crop disease detection in Kenya (May 2026). PlantVillage+ and Virtual Agronomist collectively reach 400,000–500,000 monthly users across Africa — diagnosing maize, cassava, and sorghum diseases in 20 seconds via smartphone photo, one extension worker now supporting 400+ smallholders.

label: San Francisco — Robin Autonomous Drug Discovery
sub: FutureHouse's Robin multi-agent AI system autonomously discovered ripasudil (a glaucoma drug) as a dry AMD treatment candidate — analyzing 551 papers in 30 minutes vs. 540 hours manually, then confirming efficacy in lab experiments. First documented end-to-end autonomous scientific drug discovery (Nature, June 2026).

label: San Francisco — OpenAI Rosalind Biodefense AI
sub: OpenAI launched GPT-Rosalind (May 2026) — a free frontier biodefense AI for pandemic preparedness given to governments, academic labs, and NGOs globally. Supports pathogen surveillance, outbreak modeling, vaccine prioritization. Partners: Lawrence Livermore, Johns Hopkins APL, CEPI, Five Eyes nations.

label: Ulsan, South Korea — FWI-Net Wildfire AI
sub: UNIST's FWI-Net global deep-learning model forecasts wildfire risk 31 days ahead; maintains meaningful predictive skill for an average of 22 days even in infrastructure-poor African regions, closing the disaster-information gap (June 25, 2026).

label: San Francisco — Anthropic Claude Science
sub: Anthropic launched Claude Science, a drug-discovery research workbench, plus internal programs targeting neglected diseases (rare genetic disorders, tropical diseases) that traditional pharma avoids as commercially unattractive (June 30, 2026).

label: Geneva — AI for Good Global Commission Launch
sub: Kagame, Benioff and ITU's Bogdan-Martin launched the AI for Good Global Commission (40+ founding members) on July 2, 2026, ahead of its inaugural meeting during the AI for Good Global Summit — focused on trust, equitable access, and bridging the digital divide for 2.2B people still offline.

label: Amherst, MA — MycoPermeNet TB Drug AI
sub: UMass Amherst paired high-throughput PAC-MAN screening with the MycoPermeNet AI model to predict which compounds can penetrate tuberculosis's resistant outer membrane, narrowing the search for new TB antibiotics (Nature Microbiology, July 6, 2026).

label: Geneva — AI for Good Global Summit 2026
sub: ITU's seventh AI for Good Global Summit (July 7-10, 2026) drew a record 12,000+ participants from 170 countries, alongside the UN's first Global Dialogue on AI Governance (193 nations) and the Robotics for Good Youth Challenge food-security finale (Venezuela won Junior and Senior categories).

label: Geneva — Ling Xi AI Guide Dog Debut
sub: China Mobile demonstrated Ling Xi, a $4,000 phone-controlled robotic guide dog for blind and visually impaired users, at the AI for Good Global Summit — alongside a brain-computer interface from Swiss firm Ability Neurotech supporting ALS and spinal-cord-injury patients (July 9, 2026).

label: Lisbon — WHO AI Health Governance Conference
sub: WHO convened 37 countries in Lisbon for the Global WHO Conference on Shaping AI in Health; Regional Director Hans Kluge warned the gap between AI deployment (67% of countries) and AI governance (only 8% with a strategy) is 'becoming irreversible' (July 15, 2026).

label: Kigali — Innovate Africa Challenge
sub: Smart Africa Secretariat and FAO launched the $50,000 Innovate Africa Challenge (August 2026) to scale one proven AI climate-smart agriculture solution into deployment across Ghana, Kenya, Malawi, Rwanda, and Uganda
